title: gentle-factory Design Comment Frontmatter
description: Schema for machine-readable design comment frontmatter block consumed by gentle-factory.

schema_version.description: Version of the design comment format.

issue.description: Issue number this design applies to.

ready_signal.description: Label or directive indicating human readiness.

done_when.description: Machine-checkable shell command, test path, or assertion proving completion.

items.description: Normalized repository-relative path or glob. Absolute paths, '.' or '..' segments, empty segments and protected paths (.factory/, .git/, odd/runs/, gates/) are rejected.

expected_files.description: List of expected file paths or glob patterns permitted for mutation.

gate_level.description: Depth of gate checks to execute.

budget_cap_usd.description: Lowers the matching per-node cap of the factory spec for every node of this issue's run; never raises it.

turn_cap.description: Lowers the matching per-node cap of the factory spec for every node of this issue's run; never raises it.

timeout_seconds.description: Lowers the matching per-node cap of the factory spec for every node of this issue's run; never raises it.

slice.description: true when the design delivers only part of the issue; the pull request then refers to the issue without closing it
